head: 통세척 전 준비물 챙기기
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photo on a light gray bathroom tile floor, showing washing machine cleaning supplies neatly arranged: a plastic tub of washing machine tub cleaner powder with the lid off, a pair of yellow rubber gloves, a soft microfiber cloth, and an old toothbrush, all placed beside a partially visible white front-load washing machine door. Soft natural daylight from a window, slightly diffused, casting gentle shadows. Shot straight down at 90 degrees with a smartphone camera aesthetic, realistic textures, no visible text or brand labels.
alt: 세탁기 통세척에 필요한 세척제, 고무장갑, 극세사 천, 칫솔이 세탁실 바닥에 나란히 놓여 있는 모습

head: 곰팡이와 물때, 집중 관리가 필요한 부분
prompt: Close-up realistic photo of the black rubber door gasket of a front-load washing machine, angled at 45 degrees, showing dark mold speckles and grayish mineral buildup in the folds of the rubber seal. A Korean woman's hand wearing a yellow rubber glove is pulling back the gasket fold to reveal the grime inside, with a damp microfiber cloth in her other hand. Indoor bathroom lighting, slightly cool white LED light, shallow depth of field emphasizing the gasket texture, no text or numbers visible.
alt: 세탁기 고무 패킹 틈새에 낀 검은 곰팡이와 물때를 장갑 낀 손으로 들춰 확인하는 모습

head: 세탁이 끝난 후, 문은 열어둘까 닫아둘까
prompt: Realistic photo of a white front-load washing machine in a small home laundry nook, door left wide open after a finished cycle, empty drum visible with a few water droplets glistening inside on the stainless steel walls. Soft late-afternoon sunlight streaming in from a nearby window at a low angle, creating warm highlights on the drum interior. Shot from a slight side angle at eye level, cozy realistic home interior, no text or display panel numbers visible.
alt: 세탁이 끝난 뒤 문을 활짝 열어 둔 세탁기 내부에 물기가 남아 있는 모습
